source: SDAW — Standardisierter Datensatz zur Aussenwerbung, B|A|M Bundesverband Aussenmedien
confidence: high for the record skeleton, the two loops and the field positions marked position_source=norm; the remaining positions are carried from the 2011-2013 open-source toolchain and are corroborating, not authoritative
provenance: Populated from the maintainer's structured reading of the norm, recorded 2026-09-09. This is NOT the output of a machine extraction pass over the PDF: that pass requires the source folder registered in ../local-context.md, which was not reachable from the run that created this file. Everything present here is norm-attested; what is absent is listed under `pending` and must be completed by a run that can open the PDF.
pending: The complete field list of the D record: position (1-based), length, type (Char/Num), name, meaning, value range, mandatory/optional and introduction or amendment date for every field across the minimum 499 characters.
The complete field lists of the K, S and E records.
The product-code entries inside the Produktsperren loop and the network entries inside the Netzliste loop, field by field.

field_notes.position_source: `norm` = position read from SDAW v004. `toolchain-2011-2013` = position carried from mckoch/sdxist, retained as corroboration only. Per ../local-context.md the toolchain is never a field authority; any such row is provisional until the norm confirms it.

D.name: Datensatz
D.variability: Two repeating loops extend the record beyond its 499-character minimum.

fields.name: Standortnr
fields.meaning: Site number, carrying a three-character lessee prefix.

fields.name: Stellenart
fields.meaning: Site class: main site class plus sub site class. Resolved through appendix A.
fields.note: Field width of 4 is norm-attested via the SES anomaly recorded in objektarten.json.

fields.name: AktiverStatus
fields.meaning: Whether the panel is active or blocked.

fields.name: Fotoname
fields.meaning: Site photograph filename without extension; the image ships out of band.

fields.name: MIA-Laenge (legacy)
fields.meaning: Legacy longitude in the pre-WGS84 MIA reference. Retained alongside the WGS84 pair at 466/481 rather than replaced by it.

fields.name: MIA-Breite (legacy)
fields.meaning: Legacy latitude in the pre-WGS84 MIA reference.

fields.name: Stellennr
fields.meaning: Panel number at the site; two characters cap a site at 99 panels.

fields.name: Stellennr. bis
fields.meaning: Upper bound of a panel-number range, so one record can describe a span of panels at a site.
fields.note: With the FAW-Beschreibungsbogen at 258 this accounts for the block that the 2011-2013 reconstruction reported as an undocumented gap from 256 to 395.

fields.name: FAW-Beschreibungsbogen
fields.meaning: The FAW site description sheet, encoded one criterion per character position. `X` marks the criterion as applying.
fields.value_range: `X` = applies. `Z` in positions 53-55 of the 138-character block denotes 'Zentrum'.
fields.note: 138 criteria in one positional block. Resolves the reported 140-byte 'unknown block'.

fields.name: Preis
fields.meaning: Cent per day per panel. No currency field exists in the record.

fields.name: Bauart
fields.value_range: Norm code list; S1 and S2 added 2025-04-03.

fields.name: Laengengrad (WGS84)
fields.value_range: Format 99.999999999999 — two integer digits, twelve decimals. No sign position, so no negative longitudes and nothing at or above 100 degrees.

loops.name: Produktsperren
loops.purpose: Product categories excluded from the panel, as codes from appendix B.
loops.pending: Entry field layout — offset, per-entry length and padding.

loops.name: Netzliste
loops.purpose: The networks the panel belongs to.
loops.pending: Entry field layout, and the relationship between the index range and the NetzKzf fields.

encoding.permitted_subset: X'20'-X'7E' plus the German letters A-umlaut, O-umlaut, U-umlaut, sharp s, a-umlaut, o-umlaut, u-umlaut.
encoding.padding: Space-padded fixed width, 1-based positions, no escaping.
